fixed_theta_dictionary: Theta fixes all non-raw variables: sector/history, Omega1,D, U1, coarse V, external compact-group V0, gauge and the original real selected chart. The statement does not vary V0, V or U1.

Partition original independent raw free indices into D and E. Define N from the COMPLETE exterior support envelope of all original bare Hamiltonian primitives that contain any D coordinate, including soft gauge, Haar and selected Jacobian/current terms, plus the exterior carriers of any observable under consideration. For1950 deep roots those observable carriers are wholly in D. Put F=E minus N.

This N is an envelope over the whole admitted chart, not derivative support at one point. A vanishing mixed derivative at one configuration does not establish finite support. Later old E/H1 actions or long nonlocal words are not covered.

Once the actual cutoff disintegration has established a fixed original K_D independent of n,f, the unexpanded density has exact form rho_theta(n,f) 1_K_D(a) exp[-H_DN,theta(a,n)]. All purely exterior bare terms, indicators and coordinate Jacobians are included in rho_theta once. H_DN is the sum of complete bare primitives that involve D; finite support puts all their exterior inputs in N. No division by an indicator or exterior density is needed.
kernel_independence_derivation: For each admissible exterior pair (n,f) with positive finite conditional normalizer, k_theta(a|n,f)=1_K_D(a) exp[-H_DN,theta(a,n)] / integral_K_D exp[-H_DN,theta(x,n)] dx. The right side depends on n and theta, and does not depend on f.

Exterior rho_theta can have arbitrary n-f coupling, far bad indicators or other exterior weights. They cancel only within this conditional density at fixed (theta,n,f); they do not cancel from the outer marginal or any of the four unnormalized coefficients.

For a deep original root M_p(a;theta), u_p(theta,n,f)=u_p(theta,n). Thus u_p(theta,0,f)=u_p^0(theta), independent of far RAW f. The zero reference still requires the entire original near product/chart used in1950; null marginal points may be evaluated by the well-defined mathematical conditional kernel only after this chart check.

The full raw exterior marginal pi_theta(dn,df) may now be arbitrary positive and normalized. Since u_p-u_p^0(theta) is bounded by A_p uniformly in all admitted n, the outer contribution obeys |Cov_pi_theta(u_p,u_q)|<=2 A_p A_q. Integrating far raw f introduces no additional separate conditional-mean error at fixed theta.

Therefore, conditional on exactly the1950 full real chart, original product cutoff, uniform mixed Hessian and convexity hypotheses, |Cov_original_raw|theta(M_p,M_q)| <= (2 c_K^2/m) g0^2 L_p L_q exp[-alpha dist(S_p,S_q)] + 2 A_p A_q, with the SAME A_p, original radius, depth and parameters as1950. This bound covers the actual arbitrary raw exterior marginal at fixed theta. It supplies no decay in root separation from its depth term for near-boundary roots.

No hypothesis on mixing of the far RAW marginal is required in this conditional deduction. This removes only an unnecessary far-raw response assumption. It does not remove the required physical cutoff/chart/Hessian/source background gates.
